line.text: Three sharp knocks, one softer. A pause. Then the soft one again, as if she hoped you would not hear the second.
I made extra. It would have gone bad.
Her tail flicks once, then goes still behind her. Her ears stay up, tracking you.
It's day twelve. I'm being nice. You're welcome.
You know what. Don't make me say it.

choice.prompt: She is holding the container like it personally offended her.

options.text: You remembered I hate cilantro. That's not extra, that's a meal.

reaction.text: I remembered because you complained about it for twenty minutes. It was self-defense.
Her tail curls around her ankle once before she catches it and lets it drop.
Anyway. Eat it before it gets cold. I have standards.

options.text: Extra? You made enough for three people. Who else is coming?

reaction.text: No one. I cook in batches. It's efficient.
Her ears flatten, then swivel forward again as if correcting themselves.
I'm fulfilling the terms. That's all this is.

options.text: You didn't have to bring anything. I had crackers.

reaction.text: Crackers. That's not dinner. That's a sad noise in a box.
She pushes the container into your hands. Her fingers are warm through the plastic.
Don't read into it. I just refuse to watch you waste away next door.

line.text: She steps inside without being asked. Her headband is crooked by two degrees. She fixes it, then glances at you.
Your kitchen light is still out. I noticed from the hallway. It's been three days.
You've been counting the days my light is out?
I notice things. It's a skill. Don't make it a personality trait.
She sets the container on your counter, then turns back. Her ears swivel toward you before her eyes do.
I could fix it. The light. I have a spare bulb. It's not a big deal.
The offer hangs there. Her tail flicks once, then stills. She is waiting.

choice.prompt: She is already halfway to your kitchen drawer.

options.text: You don't have to. But if you want to, I'll hold the flashlight.

reaction.text: Fine. But you hold it steady. Last time you wobbled.
Her tail wags twice before she notices and pins it still.
This doesn't count as nice. It's maintenance. Totally different category.

options.text: You just happened to have a spare bulb? For my exact fixture?

reaction.text: That's not - can you just accept the thing and not analyze it?
Her tail tucks low. She grabs the drawer handle and does not look at you.
I'm done being nice for today. The terms don't specify hours.

options.text: You're really committed to this bet, huh? Day twelve and counting.

reaction.text: I'm not counting. You're counting. I just happen to know the number.
Her ears stay flat. She sets the bulb down on the counter, harder than necessary.
Do it yourself. I have things to do.

desc: The Extra: she made too much again. The reason is thin. She knocks anyway.
